messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a small class of tenants showing invoice bumps after last week's routing-tag rollout. Looks like route_tag is getting dropped in the metering-sidecar for some long-lived sessions.

dave: Ugh. Is it the sidecar or the edge proxy stripping headers?

maria: traces point to sidecar. repro: start session -> route change -> metering event emitted without route_tag. sample log: `meter_event{tenant=t123, tokens=120, route_tag=}`

sam: Could be our async enrich path losing headers during the fanout. I can dig in.

leah: If route_tag is missing we default to fallback_plan which is cheaper in some flows, but for tenants with dedicated routing it inflates invoices. Need to be careful.

maria: Proposal: include a minimal routing context (route_id + route_tag) in the metering event envelope (not just enrich). That way downstream collectors never rely on enrich sidecar.

dave: That sounds safe. Backwards-compatible? collector should ignore if absent.

sam: Implementation note: add fields to the proto `MeterEventV2: optional string route_id, optional string route_tag` and have sidecar populate from req context. Will need consumers compiled.

leah: Console UX ask: show a small badge when route_tag is present vs. inferred. Right now invoices don't surface that.

maria: Rollout plan I'd propose: 1) add fields + consumer no-op handling, 2) canary 10% of traffic with both fields, 3) run shadow validation job to compare invoice diffs for 24h, 4) flip. Backfill missing historical events for affected tenants after flip?

dave: For backfill we'll need a dedupe token. Otherwise ledger will double-charge. Can we add `orig_event_id` to the backfill marker?

sam: Yes, include `backfill_marker: true` and `orig_event_id` in events; collector will treat markers specially. Add docs to dedupe policy.

leah: Also need a console toggle for customers to opt into early canary preview of route-tagged billing so SRE/support can validate.

maria: I'll draft the spec and proto changes. Who owns validation job? @sam?

sam: I can own the shadow validator + a quick check tool that compares invoice deltas per-tenant (sql + sampling). Will need a sampling key.

dave: Make sure we have rollout rollback playbook: switch canary off, drop backfill queue, and re-run reconciliation. Add one pager.

maria: ok creating an RFC PR. Quick action items: sam -> validator, dave -> dedupe schema, leah -> console badge + toggle, maria -> proto + RFC. 

sre-bot: deploy-notice: sidecar change will require bumping sidecar image (sidecar:v2.14) and coordinated infra deployment window (2h).

maria: noted. schedule window Weds 03:00-05:00 UTC?

dave: Works for APAC low traffic window. :thumbsup:

leah: I'll add a small dashboard card: "route_tag missing rate" and alert if >0.1% for 30m.

maria: thanks all — will open PRs and link here.
